title: The People v John Sinkamba and Others (2025/CCZ/R001) [2025] ZMCC 14 (25 July 2025)
case_name: The People v John Sinkamba and Others
issue_tags: constitutional reference from High Court (Family Division)
Children's Code Act No. 12 of 2022 section 71
outcome_detail: Constitutional reference answered: under Article 266 of the Constitution, a 'child' is an individual who has reached the age of 18 or is below the age of 18; section 2 of the Children's Code Act incorporates this same definition by reference; the Court declined to interpret section 71(2) of the Children's Code (which refers to persons below 19) as outside the scope of the referred question. Mwandenga JC rendered a concurring opinion.
